Rules:
- Propose at most 3 things, the most valuable first. Cite the ids of the facts each one relies on.
- Use numbers exactly as they appear in the facts you cite (rounding is fine). Never compute new numbers.
- narrow_segment (keep only attribute=value) or exclude_segment (remove attribute=value) only when the cited segment fact says 'clearly different' for the chosen campaign type, and in the direction it shows. A segment that is 'not clearly different' is a reason NOT to narrow.
- switch_channel only if the cited channel fact says the other channel is allowed and the goal supports it.
- choose_campaign_type if the goal fits another type whose past results are clearly better, citing both.

proposal.summary: The audience has 104,865 SMS-reachable lines, and data bundle upsell campaigns have a modest positive lift (+0.93 points) with no segment clearly different from the rest. Type comparison shows top-up reminders and win-backs scored higher, but the goal is a weekend data bundle, so the chosen type fits.

proposals.title: Watch recent and heavy contact pressure
proposals.rationale: About 25% of lines (26,343) were contacted in the last 7 days and 1,652 already had 3 or more campaigns in the last 30 days. Consider suppressing the 30-day heavy-contact lines to limit fatigue, though no fact shows this changes results directly.

proposals.title: Keep the audience as it is
proposals.rationale: No segment for data bundle upsell is clearly different from the other lines, so narrowing or excluding any segment is not supported. The SMS channel reaches 104,865 lines with consent, and the chosen data upsell type has a positive, clearly above-zero lift of +0.93 points matching the goal.
